facts.business: Apollo Sindoori Hotels Limited provides hospitality and support services, primarily food and beverage services for hospitals and healthcare institutions, along with facility management, biomedical equipment management, and housekeeping through its subsidiaries.

segments.name: Catering & Management Services - Sale of Food & beverages
Catering & Management Services - Management Service Charges

guidance_or_targets.statement: Expected CAGR of 12% over the next 3 years, supported by government focus on Make in India and increasing demand for scalable food services in industrial clusters
Targeting 15–20% annual growth over five years
EBITDA margins expected to expand with higher adoption of technology-enabled services
Projected to contribute 10–20% topline growth to the Group
The Group is expected to deliver sustainable double-digit growth over the medium term

key_risks: Rising input costs (commodities, manpower) impacting margins
Regulatory compliance costs in healthcare and aviation
Competitive intensity in facility management sector
Brand scaling risk in consumer-facing businesses
facts.related_party_note: Corporate Guarantee to Olive Plus Twist Avenue P. Ltd. of Rs. 1,823.30 lakhs as at 31 March 2026
